## Limit profile {#sec-aggregate-limit-profile}

*This is a recipe for* an **exposure/limit profile** — the same severity written across several limits (and attachments) with premium or count weights, the bread-and-butter of commercial rating. One `agg` carries the whole profile.

```{python}
from _setup import *
from textwrap import fill
# overwrite the _setup version
from aggregate import qd
```
